_doc: Combo abilities (M3): splicing both listed parts onto one chimera discovers the combo, permanently logged in the save for the Splice-Dex (M7). Combat effects resolve through the keyword system in M4 — 'keyword' here is the design intent, display-only for now. The roadmap target of 12 combos shipped with Wave 1; audit A3 added seven more alongside the nine new species, because content that arrives with no combinations is a longer list rather than a deeper game. Audit A6 added eight more, chosen so that EVERY species can appear in at least one — eleven could not, including all six chaos variants, which are the rarest things the game produces and had nothing to find. They are also weighted to the slots the first nineteen neglected: those put one hindlimb part into a combo and ten organs. M4: each combo grants its move to chimeras built with both parts. A combo must beat the best drawback-free move of the two parts that unlock it AT EVERY GRADE ASSIGNMENT, or the player discovers it and never presses it again — smoke checks all of them.

combos.name: Injection
combos.desc: Every bite delivers a bonus Venom stack. The lab smells like regret.

combos.name: Orbital Headbutt
combos.desc: Gravity-assisted disagreement. Ignores Guard.

combos.name: Squeeze Play
combos.desc: A hug with a clause. Traps the target.

combos.name: Slipstream
combos.desc: Strike, then simply decline to be there. Evasion up after attacking.

combos.name: Live Wire
combos.desc: Charge the water film on your own hide. Grounding is a suggestion.

combos.name: Depth Charge
combos.desc: Clamp down, sink, wait. The classic.

combos.name: Thunderclap
combos.desc: A charging horn and a shriek arrive together. Ears file complaints.

combos.name: Gas Lamp
combos.desc: Lure them in close, then make the air unlivable. Deeply unsporting.

combos.name: Rolling Thunder
combos.desc: Tuck into a ball, get thrown. Physics does the rest.

combos.name: Pack Hunt
combos.desc: One howl, one pounce, zero warning.

combos.name: Ink Screen
combos.desc: Ink the water, match the ink. Nobody has seen you in some time.

combos.name: Leap Year
combos.desc: Springboard into a wingbeat. Briefly, gloriously airborne.

combos.name: Full Spectrum
combos.desc: A facial disc and an echo chamber wired in series. It hears the shape of you and then tells you about it.

combos.name: Powder Keg
combos.desc: Wing scales and musk, aerosolised together. The lab has been evacuated twice.

combos.name: Nettle Curtain
combos.desc: Stinging threads on a shed skin, hung across the arena. Walking into it is a choice you make once.

combos.name: Screaming Roll
combos.desc: It tucks. It screams. It arrives anyway. Plate armour is not rated for this.

combos.name: High Water Mark
combos.desc: A wader’s patience bolted to a stooping reflex. It waits, and then it does not.

combos.name: Deterrent Display
combos.desc: Inflate to twice your size and honk about it. Nobody has ever walked away from this politely.

combos.name: Shell Game
combos.desc: An otter with a rock and an ink sac to hide the wind-up. Somewhere under one of these is a fist.

combos.name: Full Contact
combos.desc: A gorilla’s haunches supplying the legs, a ram’s skull supplying the point. Nobody involved is thinking.

combos.name: Bramble Thresher
combos.desc: A duelist’s ganglion reading the opening, and a fistful of quills going into it.

combos.name: Double Dose
combos.desc: Two unrelated venoms, delivered together, interacting in ways the paperwork calls “promising”.

combos.name: Switchback
combos.desc: Mountain footing and a stomach that runs on gravel. It is already above you.

combos.name: Ball Lightning
combos.desc: A thunderhead’s temper earthed through an eel’s skin. It hangs in the air for a moment first, which is the worst part.

combos.name: Lights Out
combos.desc: The little light goes out. Then something much larger arrives at the place you were looking.

combos.name: Siege Engine
combos.desc: Plating that walks, wound up by a gland that only knows one speed. Walls are a scheduling problem.

combos.name: Downwind
combos.desc: It gets above you, and then it is patient about the weather.
